SELECT r.RE_NUM AS rentalId, r.RE_NAME AS rentalName, ROUND(AVG(rv.RV_RATING), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(rv.RV_NUM) AS reviewCount,
c.CR_ID AS carId, c.CR_YEAR AS carYear, c.CR_FUEL_TYPE AS carFuel, c.CR_TRANS AS carTrans, c.CR_PRICE AS carPrice,
c.CR_THUMBNAIL AS thumbnail
FROM RENTAL r JOIN CAR c ON r.RE_NUM = c.CR_RE_NUM JOIN CAR_TYPE ct ON c.CR_CT_KEY = ct.CT_KEY LEFT JOIN REVIEW rv ON rv.RV_TABLE_NAME = 'rental' AND rv.RV_NUMBER = r.RE_NUM
WHERE c.CR_CT_KEY = #{ct_key} AND c.CR_YEAR = #{cr_year} AND c.CR_FUEL_TYPE = #{cr_fuel_type} AND c.CR_TRANS = #{cr_trans}
GROUP BY r.RE_NUM, c.CR_ID ORDER BY c.CR_PRICE ASC
